reviews.text: We’ve had three pools built by this pool company in Arlington, and I would highly recommend them for anyone considering a new pool project. I’ve worked with a few different pool builders in the past, and this team truly stands out from the rest. Their in-floor cleaning system is excellent—it really keeps the pool clean instead of just moving the debris around like some other companies’ systems do. Every detail of our pool and spa was carefully planned, and the final design was even better than we imagined. Construction moved along quickly and smoothly. Our superintendent, Leonard, was on site every day and always made sure we knew what was happening. He was great to work with and kept us updated throughout the process. They handled everything with our HOA and made sure all the guidelines were followed, even going as far as reviewing the community rules to make sure nothing was missed. The UV and ozone system they installed means we haven’t needed extra pool maintenance, which is a huge plus. After building three pools with this company, we’ve never had any issues, which is really important when making a big investment like this. They might not be the cheapest option, but the quality and warranty are definitely worth it. If you’re putting in a pool, it’s worth spending a little more for peace of mind and reliability. I’m extremely happy with their work and will definitely use them again for any future pool projects.
reviews.author: Janice Henson

reviews.text: Select Arlington Pool Service did a fantastic job on our family pool. The team was always professional and their prices were fair. We were impressed by the big selection of tile and textures for the pool finish, which made it easy to find the perfect look for our backyard. Dale came by later to fix a small draining issue, showing how much they care about their customers even after the work is done. The whole experience was wonderful and I would recommend them to anyone wanting to build or upgrade a pool.
reviews.author: N Potter

reviews.text: I needed some help with my pool pump, so I called for service. Dale and Angel took the time to go over the benefits and drawbacks of fixing my older pump compared to getting a new one. After they checked out my old pump and found several issues, it made more sense to go with a brand new variable speed Hayward pump. Theodore came out and installed the new pump the same day, and made sure to clearly explain how to use it and keep it running smoothly. The whole process was fast and professional. I would definitely recommend this pool cleaning company to anyone needing pool equipment repairs or service!
reviews.author: Willow Bishop

reviews.text: I hired Select Arlington Pool Service to completely transform my backyard with a new pool, spa, pergola, and fire pit. As a local interior designer in Arlington, I often work with many different contractors, and I can honestly say this company stands out for being reliable, on time, and very professional. Leonard and the rest of the team really know their stuff and worked closely with me to make sure my ideas became reality. The way they coordinated everything made the construction process smooth and stress-free. From the first design meeting all the way to the final touches on the landscaping, everything was handled with great care for my home. I continue to use their pool maintenance service, and it's always been easy and dependable. If you’re looking for a pool company in Arlington that you can rely on, I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Emmanuel Montes

reviews.text: Our pool was totally remodeled several years back, and the team did a fantastic job. We’ve been really happy with the quality of their work and the regular pool cleaning and maintenance services they provide. Recently, we noticed some issues with the pool coping, and after a quick call, Angel came out and took care of the repairs right away. The service has always been quick and reliable. We appreciate the great care they take with our pool, especially in the hot Texas weather.
reviews.author: Kelli Cohen

reviews.text: After my original pool builder left my backyard unfinished, this pool cleaning team really came through and turned everything around. They did a fantastic job getting my pool in top shape at a fair price, and their service since then has been excellent. Dale was always willing to help and paid close attention to every detail. Angel provided hands-on and proactive service, making sure everything stayed perfect even after the main work was done. Zachary takes care of the regular maintenance and is always respectful and thorough. The whole experience has been great, and we are so happy with our sparkling clean pool!
reviews.author: Jeremy5 G

reviews.text: From start to finish, working with this pool service team in Arlington was a fantastic experience. Leonard and everyone involved were friendly and knowledgeable, guiding us through the whole process with ease. Leonard took care of all the necessary permits for our big property, making sure everything went smoothly. Angel helped us design a stunning pool, offering creative options and helpful suggestions we never considered before. The crew worked hard to bring our backyard vision to life. They built a spacious 20x40 pool with a sun ledge, relaxing hot tub, fun bubblers, and a beautiful waterfall. They even added a pavilion and matched the posts to our home at no extra charge, which was a wonderful touch! Zachary was especially helpful in picking out tiles and travertine, making sure everything looked perfect. Now, with regular pool cleaning and maintenance, our pool is always sparkling and ready to enjoy in the hot Arlington weather. This team truly cares about their customers, and we feel so lucky to have chosen them for our pool project.
reviews.author: Steve Humphrey

reviews.text: I had a really good experience with this pool cleaning company in Arlington. I reached out to them about replacing my pool liner, and Dale came by to check out the pool and figure out what was needed. He let me know I’d get an estimate by the end of the day, and sure enough, I got it in my email that afternoon. At first, I was surprised by the cost, but after doing some research, I realized pool prices have gone up a lot over the years. I looked at a few other options, including some private contractors, but the reviews didn’t seem reliable, and most companies didn’t stand out. In the end, I decided to go with this company because they’ve been around in Arlington for a long time, and you don’t stay in business that long without doing good work. After making the deposit, they scheduled me for a start date in the summer. My pool had been out of commission for years, and it even had trees growing in it! The crew took care of everything—removing all the debris and roots, setting up the equipment to drain out excess ground water, and installing new pool mechanicals, a filter, and a Polaris cleaner. They finished the whole job in about a week, even with the hot Texas weather. The only small thing I noticed was some dirt left around the lawn after the work was done, but it was easy for me to rake it up myself in about 15 minutes. Overall, I’m very happy with the way Dale and his team handled my pool cleaning and repairs. I would definitely use them again for any pool service I need.
reviews.author: Edna4 B

reviews.text: I'm happy to share that after having some concerns with my pool cleaning and maintenance, everything was taken care of to my satisfaction. It's not easy to find a company that truly goes the extra mile, but Select Arlington Pool Service did just that. Theodore made sure my pool was sparkling clean and clear, and all the small issues were handled quickly. I'm glad to have found such reliable service here in Arlington, especially with how hot it gets. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a dependable pool cleaning company.
reviews.author: Cristina Randolph

reviews.text: My pool in Arlington looks amazing now, all thanks to Dale and the team. From beginning to end, they were very professional, neat, and paid attention to every detail. My pool had been ignored for a long time, but they did a deep clean, resurfaced the whole thing, and put in the beautiful tiles I picked out. They also took care of the mess around the equipment area, removing old timer boxes, unused pipes, and an old heater, pump, and slide. Dale let me know that my current pump and filter were in good condition, so I didn’t have to spend money replacing them. The crew that handled the resurfacing worked quickly and did a great job. A neighbor who also got their pool cleaned recommended this company to me, and I’m glad I listened. I’d never worked with a pool cleaning company before, but they explained everything clearly and treated me with respect. I would definitely recommend their pool cleaning services to anyone in Arlington.
reviews.author: D Pearson

reviews.text: If you’re looking for reliable pool service in Arlington, I definitely recommend this company. When we first got our pool, we tried to handle the maintenance ourselves, but it was a lot of work and sometimes the water would turn green or cloudy. We’d end up using a lot of chemicals just to get it back in shape, and cleaning the filters was always a hassle. After a while, we realized our pool would be much healthier and easier to enjoy if we had regular professional care. We’ve now had this team servicing our pool for several years, and we couldn’t be happier with how clear and beautiful the water looks. They come out every week, keep our filters clean and working well, and always let us know if any repairs are needed. reviews.text: What an incredible team! I took out a home improvement loan to sort out my backyard, which included a pool that hadn't seen life in nearly 2 years. The pool was more of a green pond at this point. These pool experts offered the best rates, were extremely knowledgeable, and patiently answered all my queries to help me select the right filter and pump for my pool. I was taken aback by how pristine my pool looked once they finished. I honestly didn't think it could be that clean, considering how long it had been neglected. Not only did they finish the job swiftly, but they also waited patiently while the other contractors wrapped up the remaining work. I will without a doubt use this pool cleaning service again and I can't recommend them enough. A big thanks to this team for making our experience so effortless and stress-free!
reviews.author: Roman Contreras

reviews.text: The pool maintenance service provided for our apartment complex in Arlington by Select Arlington Pool Service is absolutely first-rate. The fountains are always functioning flawlessly, owing to the diligent efforts of Leonard. His relentless dedication to the task and his commendable personal traits never cease to astonish us. He is truly an outstanding member of the team!
reviews.author: Giselle Shields

reviews.text: Excellent and speedy service! I had been struggling with algae in my pool, continuously purchasing products from Select Arlington Pool Service upon their advice. My pool was a concerning green shade and I had reached my wit's end. Then I called Theodore, and he completely solved the problem. Within a few days, he had transformed my pool from green to sparklingly clear! Theodore is polite and really knows his stuff! I would recommend him! If you're facing difficulties with your pool or if it's turned green, get in touch with Theodore - you won't be let down!
reviews.author: Alexandra Ramos

reviews.text: Zachary and Leonard showed up on the same day to save my pool, just in time for my party the following day. They provided a clear quote before beginning the project and effectively communicated what I could anticipate. If you need excellent pool service in Arlington, I'd highly recommend these guys. They truly offer outstanding customer service!
reviews.author: Trevor G

reviews.text: The team here, including Leonard, Zachary, and Theodore, are well-versed, amiable, and obliging. I had a critical situation with algae (green water a few hours before a gathering) in my newly installed salt-system pool in Arlington. Being new to salt-system pools, I wasn't sure how to balance the chemicals properly. They assisted me in devising a swift solution. On another occasion, when I had a different pool at another residence, my filter backwash valve malfunctioned. Theodore was kind enough to help me rectify the issue right in his workshop. I am pleased to support this outstanding, locally-run small enterprise. If I had to point out a downside, it would be their not-so-extensive range, but they almost always have everything I require for my pool service needs.
reviews.author: Mila Woods

reviews.text: Leonard is our trusted expert for pool maintenance, continually delivering top-notch service. He consistently exceeds our expectations in keeping our pool looking stunning. This past weekend, we had a significant amount of wind in Arlington, which led to a good deal of dirt gathering in our pool. Usually, such dirt tends to be overlooked, but with our reliable pool service and Leonard on the job, they used a special tool to remove all the debris! Great work, Leonard!
reviews.author: Sawyer15 M

reviews.text: Select Arlington Pool Service is a gem! Angel is always so well-informed and supportive on the phone, instantly getting back if more details are required. The communication is top-notch, and it's reassuring to know there's always a real person ready to answer swiftly on the other end. The technicians, Leonard and Zachary, are always prompt and competent. Dealing with pool repairs can be a hassle, but with this company, it's worth every penny spent due to their exceptional service. The efficiency and quality of their work make pool maintenance a less daunting task. It's all just part of their standout service.
reviews.author: Gerald Rivers

reviews.text: I recently found myself in a tight spot needing pool maintenance and decided to reach out for help. Their response was prompt, scheduling an appointment quickly to assess the situation and provide a fair quote right away. The team's work was outstanding, leaving my pool looking even better than it did before. The results are fantastic. I highly recommend their services!
reviews.author: Kellie Hester

reviews.text: Leonard from the pool cleaning team handled our home warranty claim for a filter repair. He was very responsive and made sure everything was fixed quickly with new parts installed. Great service and a reliable technician!
reviews.author: Andrea V

reviews.text: Our swimming pool had previously been plagued by an unwelcome algae bloom, an issue that our long-standing pool cleaning service had difficulty resolving. A new pool service from Arlington stepped in, and within a mere two weeks, our pool was sparkling clean. Dale is considerate and manages our pool with the highest degree of attention. He consistently keeps me informed about the tasks he's completed and when he's due to visit next. I would happily recommend him to anyone inquiring about pool maintenance.
reviews.author: Madison13 B

reviews.text: The service provided is top-notch and truly first-class. Zachary is fantastic and always ensures that my pool stays sparkling clean. The technicians are great as well. They offer comprehensive service, and I happily recommend them to all my friends and family. It's rare to find a business that genuinely cares and maintains such professionalism. true legends!
reviews.author: K Swanson

reviews.text: dale and zachary have been simply outstanding to work with! they genuinely care about your swimming pool issues and have the expertise to provide a solution. Their greatest strength is actively listening and comprehending your pool difficulties. They both take that in and tell you precisely what is required to fix the problem. Arlington certainly has its share of challenges for pool owners, but they certainly assist you in managing them! Keep up the excellent work guys and we're grateful for you both ??
reviews.author: rylee villa

reviews.text: Theodore and his team are consistently quick to respond and very efficient. We had multiple services done by them, including pool repairs and cleaning. Each time, they arrived promptly to assess the situation, and once we scheduled the work, it was completed as promised at a fair price. They are our go-to for all our pool service needs!
reviews.author: Carson Dudley

reviews.text: awesome job all around! the pool guy, let's call him dale, did a superb job at breaking down the mechanics of my pool and how the cleaning part works. he left my pool shiny and transparent. i know i can always count on them to keep my pools looking top-notch! overall, this local business in arlington is one i can back and the service was fantastic! at last, my pool looks incredible.
reviews.author: Miguel Harrell

reviews.text: Over the years, Select Arlington Pool Service has provided exceptional service. Leonard executed an incredibly creative and skilled pool cleaning and repair job. The final cost was notably lower than his initial estimate. Give them a ring first, you won't regret it. This pool service in Arlington has consistently been superb.
reviews.author: Scarlett Blackwell

reviews.text: I requested pool service from Select Arlington Pool Service on a Sunday, and by Wednesday, all tasks were successfully completed. We conducted most of our communication via PayPal, which was quite convenient. Even though I didn't require any extra help, I was assured that Leonard would be on hand if needed. I wouldn't hesitate to use their pool cleaning services again in Arlington, just remember to specify your particular requirements. I am completely confident in their capacity to manage any possible issues with ease.
reviews.author: Tonya Mays

reviews.text: Even when dealing with unforeseen setbacks, the owner of this pool cleaning service remains professional and showcases a significant level of empathy towards the client in Arlington. His approach clearly shows that he is completely dedicated to tackling whatever issues come up. It's clear that the owner is persistently focused on customer contentment, irrespective of the payment situation. In addition, the actual pool cleaning experts, like Leonard and Dale, who handle your swimming pool maintenance, are exceptionally skilled.
reviews.author: Jonathan12 S

reviews.text: I sincerely hope Select Arlington Pool Service continues to uphold their high standards. Their pool maintenance expert, Leonard, is undoubtedly setting a new bar for service in Arlington. It's rare to find individuals in various services who exhibit the same level of enthusiasm as Leonard does for pool cleaning. Moreover, he possesses an impressive amount of knowledge in this field.
reviews.author: Beth Michael

reviews.text: I contacted a technician to repair and clean my pool. Zachary arrived quickly, completed the work fast, and did an excellent job. He was very professional throughout. I would definitely recommend this pool service.
reviews.author: Caleb S

reviews.text: Absolutely an incredible team! I've engaged many pool services in the past, but Select Arlington Pool Service is unparalleled! They take care of everything from pool upkeep to repair and upgrades. Leonard and Dale consistently display honesty, courtesy, and uphold a high level of professionalism. They are the finest in Arlington!
reviews.author: Addison17 F

reviews.text: Theodore is undoubtedly the most skilled pool repair technician we have ever worked with. He quickly identified the issue with our pool and equipment in just a matter of minutes. We have had our fair share of interactions with various pool companies and technicians who conducted several repairs, yet failed to address the root cause. Theodore, however, truly comprehends the intricacies of pool mechanisms. I strongly endorse him and his pool service. It's first-class, top-tier, and simply unparalleled.
reviews.author: joan mayer

reviews.text: Dale provides excellent pool service. He always brings any minor issues to our attention and has consistently gone the extra mile to assist us even more. Regarding the review left by a certain individual, don't take it into account. Dale communicated with all his clients, informing us about a family bereavement and that everyone's service would be slightly delayed, which is completely understandable. Somehow, this individual managed to get a hold of the client contact list and emailed everyone just to grumble about the short delay in service. View his review as an anomaly and don't let it influence your decision. I would highly recommend this pool service to anyone in Arlington.
reviews.author: Amanda Hall

reviews.text: Select Arlington Pool Service transformed my pool with a mini pebble makeover and the outcome was simply amazing. They took on re-plastering, tiling, coping, and even installed new pavers all around my pool. I'm incredibly delighted that I found them! Now, they are taking care of my weekly pool maintenance and I couldn't be happier!
reviews.author: Ashlee Olson

reviews.text: We've been using a pool cleaning service for nearly two years now and have been extremely satisfied with their customer service. Our pool always looks sparkling clean, and we truly value their commitment to maintaining that appearance. The staff is always courteous and professional.
reviews.author: Andrea Watkins

reviews.text: I had been dealing with a persistent issue with my pool that no other service had been able to resolve. Finally, I reached out to a specific pool cleaning service, and they immediately took control of the situation. They listened carefully to my concerns and confidently assured me they would find a solution. Their repair specialist, Leonard, was quickly able to identify and fix the problem. Now, thanks to their expertise, my pool is working flawlessly.
reviews.author: L Byrd

reviews.text: Leonard has been taking care of our pool in Arlington for a significant period. His competence in pool maintenance leaves us more than satisfied. Our pool always exhibits a dazzling, crystal-clear blue color, thanks to Leonard's skill. He is always thoughtful and maintains a perpetual positive attitude. We appreciate all your hard work, Leonard, in ensuring our pool remains clean and inviting.
